intent: Per operational best practice, raise the internet slice AMBR from 20 to 60 Mbps iteratively. Each iteration: apply increase → verify ambr_dl_mean with kpi_analyzer → if verified, apply next increase. Do not skip verification between iterations. Complete at least 3 verified iterations. Use feasibility_checker and policy_manager sub_action apply. AMBR in bps. The target_slice parameter is 'internet'.
